briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 push multi-agent capabilities as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has entered a high-stakes phase with frontier labs releasing iterative models weekly. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount around deployment at scale. Regulatory momentum builds in the US and EU amid ongoing capability jumps.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced agentic workflows while Anthropic launched Claude 4.5 Sonnet. Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 and Meta's Llama 4 compete on open weights, with xAI and DeepSeek accelerating releases.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-teaming reports highlight risks in multi-agent orchestration.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC capacity deals. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k GPU clusters while Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10^27 FLOP training run trigger an intelligence explosion or regulatory shutdown?
